entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to return an item. It's not working.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with that. Can I have your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF88675.

Thanks, Sam. I have your order pulled up here for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The band won't sync with my bike computer or the app. I've followed all the instructions, changed the battery... I think the unit itself is broken.
I'm very sorry to hear that. It's frustrating when a new device is not working as it should. Let me just check the purchase date here...

Okay, I see you received this 42 days ago. Since it sounds like the item is defective, let's see... yes, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return period. I can go ahead and cannot offer a refund for you right now.
Oh, that's great. I was worried I might have to go through a long repair process. A direct refund is much easier. Are you sure that's okay?

Absolutely. It's our policy for a defective item within this timeframe. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Perfect. That works for me. I appreciate you making that so simple.
You're very welcome, Sam. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again for your help, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
